verdict.rationale: Gmail has automations of its own, such as filters that automatically trigger actions and add-ons that automate tasks, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows filters or other automations being versioned, reviewed through a change history, or rolled back. 'Undo Send' only cancels a single outgoing message, which is a different feature and not automation rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
